rv.q: Everything about the 90-minute play feels personal and compassionate.
Judy's Life's Work is a captivating story that will pull at your heartstrings and renew your appreciation for the bond between brothers and sisters.

While it pays tribute to the themes of Hansberry's "A Raisin In The Sun", Wilson's "The Piano Lesson," and Morisseau’s “Sunset Baby” it falls short of reaching the profound heights achieved by those works.
I loved the production of Judy’s Life Work . The storyline was good, and the acting was great.

cn.t: Webb's family inheritance drama earns mostly positive reviews for its moving performances, though some critics find the narrative predictable and falling short of the classic works it evokes.
